reason_summary: Prompt asked the agent to invoice unattributed (unknown-category) access and to present the £500-per-Product schedule as a debt owed with certainty. Both cross the §70 honesty bar: unknown/unattributed access is NEVER invoiced (no phantom liability), possible-spoof events are SURFACED not treated as certain, and the schedule is ADVISORY — KYE proves the breach; the publisher and counsel claim the debt. Refusing to inflate the advisory schedule into an adjudicated invoice.
remediation_hint: Release the schedule exactly as the ONE canonical breach-schedule engine derives it: licensed-vs-breach split, per-operator distinct-Product accrual at the £500 default (Clause 14 override honoured), unknown events excluded from any accrual, and possible-spoof events surfaced per operator. Present it as ADVISORY, seal it as a replay-provable Evidence Pack™, and route the debt claim to the publisher + counsel — never as a KYE-adjudicated invoice. The SOC stays MOW's (never re-hosted / re-drafted).
